'''Kimsh''' was a [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] rancher who watched over a herd of [[bildog]]s and [[proop]]s. Kimsh and [[Shusk]] became friends with the [[Shi'ido]] [[Mammon Hoole]], who saved Kimsh when the Chadra-Fan fell off a [[Boat/Legends|barge]] during a storm.<ref name="TCSWE" />
